brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases in a straight row at q=-1,0,1,2 (piece:-1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0), each holding a drained soil bin (three third-depth drained bins in the pipe cells, one full-depth drained bin at the end cell) planted with cabbage props. check_build: no issues, meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: A run (run:run-1) starts at the west cell (-1,0) and passes straight through (0,0) and (1,0) to the east cell (2,0)'s face, so the pipe runs through all four bases. No port or barb fitting was added to connect the pipe to each cell's soil, and the run mode was left at its default (setRunMode could not address the run). The configurator checks fit only, so whether it delivers water to every cell is not verified.

requirements.requirement: Suitable for water/planting use (material, waterproofing, potable safety)
requirements.evidence: The configurator does not check materials, waterproofing or potable-water safety; the choice of printed material is up to the user. Not verified.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell planter: four hex bases in a row, each with a drained soil bin, capped with solid end caps, joints bolted, and cabbage plants in each cell. A water pipe run goes through the bases from the west end to the east end, so it passes through every cell. I did not add barb ports to connect the pipe to each cell, and the run mode is default. The mesh check is clear. Water delivery and material suitability are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
